# @surfaces-ui/chat

Chat thread components for Surfaces UI: streaming replies, tool steps, approvals and inline agent-drawn components.

Chat threads whose replies hold live components: streaming text, tool steps, approvals, and any catalog component drawn inline. `AnalyticsChat` adds conversations, a data panel and agent setup. It talks to any `AgentBackend` and never to a model itself.

## Install

```bash
npm install @surfaces-ui/chat react react-dom
```

`react` and `react-dom` are peer dependencies: your app provides them.

## Use

```tsx
import { Chat } from "@surfaces-ui/chat";
import { DataSourceProvider } from "@surfaces-ui/components";
import { connectAgent, connectDataSource } from "@surfaces-ui/client-connect";

const data = connectDataSource({ baseUrl: "http://localhost:5220" });
const agent = connectAgent({ baseUrl: "http://localhost:5220" });

<DataSourceProvider dataSource={data}>
  <Chat agent={agent} starters={["Show the data model"]} />
</DataSourceProvider>;
```

## Part of Surfaces UI

Surfaces UI is a UI library for data and analytics: exploring schemas, querying, charting, tables at scale, chat, and pages an agent can build.
